metadata.description:
A 5-step partner search refinement workflow for quantum computing research.
Tests incremental filter application where each step narrows the search results.
The scenario validates that filters accumulate across turns and the system
remembers previous filter criteria when adding new constraints.

changes: Added _detect_partner_search_refinement() method to detect follow-up refinement queries
Added _get_partner_refinement_hint() method to provide tool hints for refinement queries
Added _extract_topic_from_context() method to extract original topic from conversation context
Added _get_countries_for_group() method to map regional groups to country lists
Added pre-routing in _reason_next_step() to bypass LLM for obvious refinement cases
fix_history.tools_fixed: All turns now correctly use find_experienced_partners instead of search_documents
